topic.title: Git Actions in Other Views and Editors

body.p: In addition to the dedicated Git views and the top-level Git menu, the Git Client add-on contributes Git actions to context menus in other parts of . The actions apply to the resource you right-click. If the resource is not part of a Git repository, Git actions are not available. In the Project view, right-clicking a folder that is not part of a Git repository shows only Create repository here.

section.title: Where Contextual Git Actions Are Available
section.p: The contextual actions are available for resources that belong to a Git repository in the following locations:

dlentry.dd: Right-click a file or folder and select the Git submenu.
Right-click a topic reference or map reference and select the Git submenu.
Right-click in an editor opened in Text or Author mode and select the Git submenu.

section.title: Contextual Git Actions
section.p: Depending on the selected resource and context, the Git submenu can include the following actions:

ul.li: Git Diff - Compares the selected resource.
Commit - Starts a commit for the selected resource.
Show history - Opens history for the resource.
Show blame - Shows line-level revision information.
Create repository here - Initializes a repository in the selected folder.
